name: STRONG Singapore

brand_voice.summary: Energetic, confident and encouraging. Performance-minded without being intimidating. STRONG sells one efficient, coach-led 45-minute class that combines strength, cardio and Pilates-inspired training.
signature_phrases: Strength, cardio and Pilates in one class
rules: Always write the brand name as STRONG in capitals.
Say "Pilates-inspired" when describing the training method. "Strength, Pilates and cardio" is fine as a three-part list.
Reference the 45-minute class length where relevant.
Reassure beginners that they do not need to be the fittest person in the room.
avoid: Shame-based fitness language (no excuses, crush it, beast mode)
Implying the viewer is unfit or overweight (Meta personal attributes policy)
Calling STRONG a pure Pilates studio

products.name: STRONG class
products.description: 45-minute coach-led full-body class combining strength (resistance), cardio and Pilates-inspired movement on one machine. High intensity, low impact, progressive.
